subject: Request: temporary SOC 2 attestation / bridge letter to meet PO cutover
messages:
From: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@cedarpointhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@cedarpointhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-27T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 attestation needed to finalize PO schedule

Hi Ben,

We're finalizing the PO for the expansion and procurement wants confirmation of coverage through our billing cutover on Oct 15. Legal indicates they need either your latest SOC 2 Type II report or a temporary attestation/bridge letter that covers the period Oct 1–Oct 31 so the PO can be issued and the contract signed by our finance team.

Attached is our internal PO timeline (see CedarPoint_PO_Timeline.xlsx). Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide either: 1) a signed bridge letter for the specified window, or 2) confirmation that the 2025 Type II report suffices for internal auditors?

We appreciate a quick turn — procurement plans to route the PO next Wednesday (Oct 6) and needs the attestation language to avoid delays.

Thanks,
Marco Diaz
Procurement Manager
CedarPoint Health
[Attachment: CedarPoint_PO_Timeline.xlsx]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@cedarpointhealth.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-27T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 attestation needed to finalize PO schedule

Hi Marco — thank you for the timeline and context. Short answer: we can provide a temporary bridge/attestation that covers the Oct 1–31 window, and I can circulate a draft today for your legal team to review.

Quick notes on process and timing:
- I'll attach our most recent Type II (SOC2_TypeII_Redwood_2025.pdf) for reference.
- I need internal approvals from Legal and Finance for the bridge wording (one-time sign-off).
- If CedarPoint can accept a signed PDF bridge (no notarization), we can turn this in 2–3 business days after approvals. If you need DocuSign or additional contract amendments, add 48 hours.

Next steps: I'll loop in Lauren (legal ops) and Jordan (sales ops) to confirm the approval path and get a draft over by EOD. Can you share the exact language or PO clause your auditors require (or confirm a short statement will be sufficient)?

Ben Carter
Sr. Strategic Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: SOC2_TypeII_Redwood_2025.pdf]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-27T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 attestation needed to finalize PO schedule — bridge letter approval path

Ben / Jordan — forwarding Marco's request. Summary and asks:

1) Request: signed temporary attestation/bridge covering Oct 1–31 so procurement can issue PO by Oct 6.
2) Acceptable deliverables: signed PDF bridge letter (preferred) OR inclusion of standard attestation clause in PO followed by PDF.
3) Risk notes: we must avoid implying coverage outside our SOC2 scope. Keep language limited to: "Redwood Inference attests that, to the best of its knowledge, there are no material changes in controls since the reporting period ending 2025-12-31 and the organization maintains SOC 2 controls consistent with the scope of the attached report."

Approval path I propose: Legal Ops (me) + Finance Ops (Jordan) sign-off. No additional exec signature required unless they request expanded warranties.

Jordan — can you confirm Finance is ok with the proposed wording and turnaround (2–3 business days)? If yes, Ben please send the draft and I'll sign off as Legal Ops.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Legal Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-27T12:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC 2 attestation needed to finalize PO schedule — bridge letter approval path

Lauren — Finance is comfortable with the proposed conservative language (no new warranties). We'll prioritize sign-off. If the customer requests DocuSign, we can route through finance ops the same day the signed PDF is available.

I'll block time to review the draft this afternoon.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@cedarpointhealth.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-29T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Draft bridge letter (attached) + delivery plan for PO cutover

Marco — attaching a draft bridge letter for CedarPoint's legal review (temp_bridge_letter_draft.docx). This follows the conservative language Lauren suggested.

Key points:
- Bridge covers Oct 1–31, 2026.
- Statement limited to "no material changes in controls since the reporting period ending 2025-12-31" and references the attached SOC 2 Type II report.
- Signing plan: Legal Ops (Lauren) + Finance Ops (Jordan) will sign and return a PDF. Target turnaround: by Oct 1 EOD. If you need DocuSign, confirm and we'll convert.

I'll include the signed PDF in a reply once approvals are in.

Ben Carter
Sr. Strategic Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: temp_bridge_letter_draft.docx, SOC2_TypeII_Redwood_2025.pdf]

From: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@cedarpointhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@cedarpointhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft bridge letter (attached) + delivery plan for PO cutover

Ben — received, thanks. Your draft looks aligned with what our auditors need. Procurement confirms PO routing on Oct 6 provided we receive the signed bridge by Oct 3 EOD. DocuSign is preferred but not mandatory.

Please advise when you have the signed PDF and whether Redwood can add a single-line reference to the signed bridge in the PO body (we typically add: "Seller's SOC 2 bridge letter dated Oct 1, 2026 references the Seller's SOC 2 Type II report for the period ending Dec 31, 2025"). If that phrasing is fine, we will include it when generating the PO.

Best,
Marco
Procurement Manager
CedarPoint Health
